testcase.name: the archive carries every part a spreadsheet reader needs
markup in a title is escaped and reads back as the original text
a block with hand set times is kept out of the grid but kept in the detail sheet
the workbook declares five sheets and 周课表 is the first
the same snapshot always produces the same bytes
a task with no recorded estimate writes an empty cell rather than a zero
an empty snapshot still produces a readable archive
the week pattern survives the round trip
a week pattern the notation cannot express is kept out of the grid
tasks are grouped by category so the sheet reads in a stable order
a grid course comes back through the real importer at the same minutes
the task sheet carries a repeat column in the user's own words
a padded title is kept out of the grid because the reader trims every cell
minutes are written as numbers so a spreadsheet can sum the column
the task sheet puts the estimate next to the actual
a category with nothing invested is left out of the category sheet
the repeat labels in the sheet are the ones the editor shows
the weekday column follows the day of the block
the daily sheet covers the same thirty days as the insight page
a week pattern the reader would normalise is kept out of the grid
a title that merely contains a week pattern is kept out of the grid
a different snapshot produces different bytes
two blocks sharing a span and a day share one cell joined by a newline
rows are ordered by period so the sheet reads like a day
a block the grid refused does not appear in a re-import
a single period block is written as one number rather than a range
a title containing a week pattern is kept out of the grid even when the block has one
a block on the period clock is written as its period span
